name: taskmaster
description: Idea-to-execution clarification: brainstorm fuzzy ideas into approved designs, grill requirements until zero ambiguity, deliberate the implementation approach with a blind four-persona round (via the approaches plugin when installed; inline 2-3 approaches otherwise), decide visual choices with mockups, validate whole experiences with an interactive clickable demo, then emit milestone-grouped single-prompt task cards. Outputs live under taskmaster-docs/ (no collision with a project's own docs/).

cc_boost.title: Boost hooks (CC_BOOST)
cc_boost.description: Boost hooks that raise model and effort when a prompt carries an ultra- token: on or off. The environment variable CC_BOOST overrides this. Set in the shell, the variable mutes every plugin at once, while this option mutes only this plugin.

cc_cardlint.title: Unlinted card-set notice (CC_CARDLINT)
cc_cardlint.description: Say when a card set reaches execution without its author-time linters having run: on or off. The environment variable CC_CARDLINT overrides this.

cc_clarify_gate.title: Clarify gate (CC_CLARIFY_GATE)
cc_clarify_gate.description: Refuse the first code write after a work-shaped prompt, once per session: block or off. The environment variable CC_CLARIFY_GATE overrides this.

cc_preview_guard.title: Preview guard (CC_PREVIEW_GUARD)
cc_preview_guard.description: Ask before an HTML page is published as a remote artifact instead of served locally: on or off. The environment variable CC_PREVIEW_GUARD overrides this.

cc_remind.title: Reminder hooks (CC_REMIND)
cc_remind.description: Reminder hooks that add guidance to the session: on or off. The environment variable CC_REMIND overrides this. Set in the shell, the variable mutes every plugin at once, while this option mutes only this plugin.

taskmaster_boost.title: ultra-task and ultra-goal boost (TASKMASTER_BOOST)
taskmaster_boost.description: The ultra-task and ultra-goal prompt boosts that raise model and effort: on or off. The environment variable TASKMASTER_BOOST overrides this.
